name: mp4-split
description: ISO BMFF parser — splits fragmented MP4 into init + per-track segments. Supports split_init mode for single-track init segment extraction.

modes.default: Splits fragmented MP4 into init + per-track segments (reads /input/fragmented.mp4)
modes.split_init: Strips non-target tracks from init segment (reads /input/command.json + /input/init.bin)
